---
title: "Taboot Hasan Ka Qaiser Abbas"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Rizwan"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Zakhmi Howa Hai Teeron Se Haye Taboot Hasan Ka.
Our Surkh Ho Gaya Hai Haye Rang Bhi Kafan Ka.
Apne Jigar Ko Thamay Shabbar Tarap Rahe Hain.
Bhai Ki Bekasi Pe Shabeer Ro Rahe Hain.
Do Jag Mein Ho Raha Hai Matam Sheh-e-Zaman Ka.
Taboot-e-Mujtaba Par Jo Teer Aa Rahe Hain.
Aal-e-Nabi Ke Dil Par Woh Zulm Dha Rahe Hain.
Murjha Gaya Hai Guncha Zahra Tere Chaman Ka.
Shabbar Ka Lasha Wapis Shabeer La Rahe Hain.
Zainab Ke Sath Mil Kar Paikaan Nikaltay Hain.
Jari Howa Lahu Phir Haider Ke Gulbadan Ka.
Abbas Ko Wafa Ne Paband Kar Diya Hai.
Warna Janaza Rokay Kis Mein Yeh Hosla Hai.
Seene Mein Ho Raha Hai Ahsas Ik Ghutan Ka.
 Rizwan Ka Yeh Noha Qaiser Ne Youn Parha Hai.
Matam Bapa Howa Hai Giriya Na Ruk Saka Hai.
Maula Ne Izn Bakhsha Dono Ko Hai Sukhan Ka.

from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/taboot-hasan-ka-qaiser-abbas-tajpoints-566a4fcc0ef002bd4291.md')
head, roman = p.read_text().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, tail = roman.split('---\\n', 1)
names = 'Hasan Shabbar Shabeer Sheh-e-Zaman Mujtaba Nabi Zahra Zainab Haider Abbas Rizwan Qaiser'.split()
lines = []
for line in roman.splitlines():
    verse = line.strip().capitalize()
    for name in names:
        verse = re.sub(r'\\b' + name + r'\\b', name, verse, flags=re.I)
    lines.append('  ' + verse)
p.write_text(head + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join(lines) + '\\n---\\n' + tail)

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Urdu script, preserving their order and single-stanza layout. Retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Our” as اور and “Wapis” as واپس in the Urdu body. Only the selected lyric changed, and `git diff --check` passed.
